design_philosophy: Rugged, technical, no-nonsense precision. Optimized for shop floor environments with harsh lighting, dirty environments, and gloved hands. Emulates the interface of digital calipers (Mitutoyo) and modern CNC command centers.

rules: CRITICAL: All numerical specifications, dimensions, thread sizes, and wire measurements MUST use 'font-mono' and 'tabular-nums' for precise vertical alignment and scanning.
Headings should be bold and tracking-tight.
Do NOT use generic consumer fonts like Inter for main headings. Use a technical geometric sans.
Avoid ultra-thin weights. Shop floor readability requires medium to bold weights.

spacing_and_layout.padding_scale: p-4 for compact areas, p-6 for standard containers.
spacing_and_layout.tap_targets: CRITICAL: Minimum tap target size must be h-14 (56px) or h-16 (64px) to accommodate machinists wearing gloves. Spacing between interactive elements must be generous.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style grids for spec layouts. Use gap-4 between data points for high density but clear separation.
spacing_and_layout.corner_radius: rounded-sm or rounded-md (4px-6px). Do NOT use large rounded corners (rounded-xl/2xl) as they feel like consumer toys, not precision industrial tools.

components.cards: Flat background (bg-[#171717]), 1px solid border (border-[#ffffff1a]), NO drop shadows. Technical UI favors stark lines over soft elevations.
components.buttons: Primary actions: bg-[#FFB000] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide. Large hit areas (min-h-[56px]).
components.segmented_controls: Use for Unified vs Metric and Internal vs External. bg-[#171717] with active state bg-[#262626] and a 2px bottom border of #FFB000.
components.inputs: Search bars and 3-wire inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#ffffff1a] focus:border-[#FFB000] text-lg font-mono. Large height (h-14).
components.tables_lists: Thread lists must be dense enough to scan but spaced enough to tap (h-16 per row). Use border-b border-[#ffffff1a] for separators.

iconography.style: Use technical, geometric icons with 2px or 2.5px stroke width for maximum visibility.
iconography.instructions: Use standard clear icons. Search (magnifying glass), Settings (cog), Back (chevron-left).

development_rules.file_extensions: Use .js extensions for all component and screen files.
development_rules.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, list items, toggles, selectors) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="thread-list-item-1/4-20"`, `data-testid="system-toggle-metric"`, `data-testid="search-input"`).
development_rules.styling_engine: Tailwind CSS via NativeWind for React Native. Translate web CSS patterns to React Native compatible Tailwind classes (e.g., avoid `backdrop-blur` or unsupported CSS properties, rely on solid backgrounds).
development_rules.platform_specifics: Ensure safe area insets are respected for top header and bottom sections.
